dataset: Atticus Open Contract Dataset (AOK Beta / CUAD v1)

split.method: Same seeded split as train_and_evaluate.py: sorted training contract IDs shuffled with seed 42, then 80% fit / 20% validation
split.leakage_check: pass; fit and validation contract IDs are disjoint

preprocessing.fit_on: fit/training portion only for each max_features value

selection.tie_breaker: smallest absolute train-validation Macro F1 gap
